title: Graph-based chain construction API for gf2-sim
description:
## Goal

Implement the lower-level graph API for novel-chain construction:
`Chain::new().add(stage).connect(a, b)?.build()?`. Runtime
type-checking on connector compatibility; branching DAG topology
support (fan-out / fan-in, no cycles). Designed in Phase 0 §9.

## Context

Task under story `bcf7776d` (CPU foundation) within epic `gf2-sim`
(`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §9 (layered API), §1 (owns
`crates/gf2-sim/src/graph/`). Wave A.2 fan-out from `118a0091`; no
inter-A.2 deps. The typestate preset (`81d05bab`) is implemented on
top of the graph API.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-sim/src/graph/mod.rs` containing:
   - `pub struct Chain` with internal `Vec<Box<dyn AnyStage>>` and
     `Vec<Edge>`.
   - `Chain::new()`, `Chain::add(stage) -> StageId`,
     `Chain::connect(from: StageId, to: StageId) -> Result<(),
     BuildError>` with runtime connector type check.
   - `Chain::build() -> Result<Pipeline, BuildError>` performing
     topological sort, multi-input / multi-output dispatch order,
     and cycle detection.
   - `BuildError` variants per design-doc §9:
     `Cyclic`, `TypeMismatch { from: TypeId, to: TypeId }`,
     `Disconnected`, `NoFallback { gpu_stage: StageId }`.
2. Branching DAG support: a stage with multiple outputs (e.g. a
   demap stage feeding two parallel decoders for diversity) and
   multiple inputs (e.g. a fusion stage). The topology executor
   in Phase C (`de160fc5`) consumes the resulting Pipeline; this
   task only needs to produce a correctly ordered Pipeline.
3. Fallback registration: `Chain::register_fallback(gpu_stage:
   StageId, cpu_stage: StageId)` for the OOM path (design-doc §8).
4. Doc example in rustdoc of `Chain` showing a DVB-T2 BICM chain
   constructed step-by-step.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] DVB-T2 BICM chain expressible via the graph API (full
  forward + inverse chain) and `build()` produces a Pipeline that
  matches the typestate-builder preset output for a fixed input.
- [hard] Cycle detection: `tests/cyclic_chain.rs` builds a cyclic
  chain and asserts `BuildError::Cyclic`.
- [hard] Type-mismatch detection: `tests/type_mismatch.rs` connects
  incompatible Stage<I,O> pairs and asserts `BuildError::TypeMismatch`.
- [hard] Disconnected detection: chain with multiple roots /
  multiple sinks yields `BuildError::Disconnected`.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- No turbo / feedback-loop topology (epic non-goal).
- No GPU-aware ordering (owned by Phase C `de160fc5`).
- No async-stream concurrency (owned by `75c22fa8`).
